title: WPForms Setup
description: Configure WPForms for reliable lead capture — forms, notifications, spam protection, and integrations.

steps.title: Activate WPForms License
steps.instructions: Install WPForms and activate the client's license tier. Enable only add-ons the project requires (CRM, payments, surveys).

steps.title: Build Core Forms
steps.instructions: Create contact, quote, and support forms with logical field order, placeholders, and required field validation.

steps.title: Configure Notifications & Confirmations
steps.instructions: Set admin notification emails and user confirmation messages. Use smart tags for dynamic subject lines and routing.

steps.title: Enable Spam Protection
steps.instructions: Turn on hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA, or Akismet. Test that legitimate submissions pass and bot submissions are rejected.

steps.title: Verify Entry Storage
steps.instructions: Confirm entries save in WPForms if the plan includes it. Export a sample entry and restrict access to trusted roles.

steps.title: Connect CRM or Email Integrations
steps.instructions: Map fields to Mailchimp, HubSpot, or other connectors. Run a test submission and confirm the contact appears in the external system.

steps.title: Embed Forms & Test UX
steps.instructions: Add forms via block or shortcode on target pages. Test mobile layout, multi-page flows, and file uploads if used.
